title: FakePlayersPack
description: Adds fake players to your world (requires Carpet Mod)!
body:
# FakePlayers

This datapack adds **fake players** to your Minecraft world!
Each one of them does something different - for example mining, building, planting trees,...

**Warning:** This datapack only works with Carpet Mod installed.

You can configure the actions of the players by editing the `start_player.function` (runs at player join) and `tick_player.function` (runs every tick) files. There is a premade list of players. I also left a **Python script** to easily generate new player files.
